planets.name: WASP-117 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-117 with a 10-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: WASP-117 b was found in 2014 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-117. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
